name: TestVerdict
description: Universal test & code coverage PR decorator and merge gate for every test report format.
author: Steve Swinsburg

inputs.name: files
inputs.label: Coverage report files
inputs.helpMarkDown: Newline or comma-separated glob patterns for coverage report files.

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Config file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional path to a .test-verdict.yml config file.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.label: Exclude source paths
inputs.helpMarkDown: Newline or comma-separated glob patterns of source paths to exclude.

inputs.name: minDiffLine
inputs.label: Minimum PR diff line coverage (%)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minimum PR diff (changed lines) coverage percentage (0-100).

inputs.name: minDiffBranch
inputs.label: Minimum PR diff branch coverage (%)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minimum PR diff branch coverage percentage (0-100).

inputs.name: diffBase
inputs.label: Git diff base ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional git ref to diff against. Defaults to System.PullRequest.TargetBranch on PR builds.

inputs.name: enforce
inputs.label: Enforce thresholds
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when coverage thresholds are breached.

inputs.name: failOnEmpty
inputs.label: Fail on empty reports
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail when no coverage report files match the configured globs.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Post PR comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Post or update a sticky pull request comment thread with coverage results.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.label: Upload Build Summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upload the full coverage breakdown to the Azure Pipelines Build Summary tab.

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Report title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Title displayed at the top of PR comments and Build Summaries.

inputs.name: reportId
inputs.label: Report ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Unique identifier for sticky PR comments when running multiple steps.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: Azure DevOps token override
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional PAT or OAuth token override. Defaults to the pipeline SystemVssConnection token.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Working directory containing the repository and coverage reports (defaults to Build.SourcesDirectory).

outputVariables.name: lineCoverage
outputVariables.description: Overall line coverage percentage, or empty if unavailable.

outputVariables.name: branchCoverage
outputVariables.description: Overall branch coverage percentage, or empty if unavailable.

outputVariables.name: functionCoverage
outputVariables.description: Overall function coverage percentage, or empty if unavailable.

outputVariables.name: diffCoverage
outputVariables.description: PR diff line coverage percentage, or empty if unavailable.

outputVariables.name: passed
outputVariables.description: Whether all configured thresholds passed (true or false).

outputVariables.name: summaryJson
outputVariables.description: JSON summary of the evaluation result.
